faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your visit to Lumen Dental.

0.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
0.answer: Yes, we work with most major insurance providers and will help you maximize your benefits. We also offer flexible payment plans for treatments not fully covered.

1.question: How do I book an appointment online?
1.answer: Simply visit our booking page, choose your preferred service and time slot, and you'll receive instant confirmation along with reminders before your visit.

2.question: What should I expect at my first visit?
2.answer: Your first visit includes a comprehensive exam, digital X-rays if needed, and a relaxed conversation about your dental history and goals before we recommend any treatment.

3.question: Are your services suitable for children?
3.answer: Absolutely. Our team specializes in gentle, friendly pediatric care designed to make kids feel comfortable from their very first appointment.

4.question: How long does teeth whitening last?
4.answer: Results typically last 6 to 12 months depending on your diet and oral care habits. We'll share simple tips to help your results last longer.

5.question: Do you offer emergency appointments?
5.answer: Yes, we reserve same-day slots for dental emergencies. Call our office directly and our team will get you in as quickly as possible.

paragraphs.0: Lumen Dental began with a simple idea: dental visits shouldn't feel clinical and cold. Our founders set out to design a practice where natural light, soft textures, and unhurried conversations replace the sterile hum most people associate with the dentist's chair.
paragraphs.1: Today, Lumen is a home for families across the city who want honest, modern dental care without the anxiety. From a child's first cleaning to a parent's restorative work, we treat every visit as a chance to build trust, not just fix teeth.
paragraphs.2: We invested in the latest digital imaging and gentle techniques, but what really sets us apart is how our team listens first and explains everything clearly, so you always know what's happening and why.
